description: This file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript, specifically an ES module (.mjs), that orchestrates build and runtime processes related to a project, including dependency management, build stamping, and build triggers.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes file paths to use forward slashes for consistency.

methods.name: isIgnoredSourcePath
methods.description: Determines if a source path should be ignored based on its filename (like test files).

methods.name: isBuildRelevantSourcePath
methods.description: Checks if a source path matches source file patterns and is not ignored.

methods.name: isBuildRelevantRunNodePath
methods.description: Determines if a given repository path is relevant for build triggers based on configuration.

methods.name: isRestartRelevantExtensionPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is relevant for extension restart based on metadata files.

methods.name: isRestartRelevantRunNodePath
methods.description: Determines if a repo path affects restart triggers based on configuration.

methods.name: statMtime
methods.description: Gets the last modification time of a file synchronously, handling errors.

methods.name: isExcludedSource
methods.description: Checks if a source file should be excluded based on source roots and relevance.

methods.name: findLatestMtime
methods.description: Recursively finds the latest modification time within a directory, with optional skip logic.

methods.name: readGitStatus
methods.description: Runs 'git status' to get the current status of watched files.

methods.name: parseGitStatusPaths
methods.description: Parses output from 'git status' to extract paths.

methods.name: hasDirtySourceTree
methods.description: Determines if there are uncommitted changes in the watched source tree.

methods.name: readBuildStamp
methods.description: Reads and parses the build stamp JSON file to get build metadata.

methods.name: hasSourceMtimeChanged
methods.description: Checks if any source file has been modified more recently than the build stamp.

methods.name: resolveBuildRequirement
methods.description: Determines if a rebuild is necessary based on various factors like config, git head, and source changes.

methods.name: formatBuildReason
methods.description: Converts build reason codes to human-readable labels.

methods.name: logRunner
methods.description: Logs messages related to build execution, respects environment variable for enabling/disabling.

methods.name: runOpenClaw
methods.description: Spawns a process to run the main openclaw script and waits for its completion.

methods.name: syncRuntimeArtifacts
methods.description: Runs post-build steps to synchronize runtime artifacts.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Writes current build metadata to the build stamp file.

methods.name: runNodeMain
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the build and run process, including build checks, building, and execution.
